challenge: Declining market share in wealth management amid fintech disruption and shifting client demographics, with legacy technology infrastructure limiting digital engagement capabilities.
approach: Conducted a comprehensive digital maturity assessment and competitive landscape analysis. Developed a three-phase transformation roadmap prioritizing client-facing digital capabilities while modernizing core banking infrastructure. Facilitated executive alignment workshops and established a dedicated transformation office.
results: 32% increase in digital client engagement within 18 months. Acquired 2,400 new high-net-worth clients through enhanced digital onboarding. Achieved $14M in operational cost savings through process automation.

challenge: Portfolio of 12 business units with varying growth profiles and margin structures, lacking a cohesive capital allocation strategy and carrying two underperforming divisions that were diluting overall returns.
approach: Applied our proprietary portfolio valuation framework to assess each business unit across strategic fit, market attractiveness, competitive position, and financial performance. Modeled multiple portfolio configurations and developed a phased restructuring plan including targeted divestitures and reinvestment priorities.
results: Successful divestiture of two non-core divisions generating $890M in proceeds. Reinvestment into three high-growth segments increased portfolio ROIC from 11.2% to 16.8%. Total shareholder return exceeded peer index by 24% over two years.

challenge: Seeking to expand into adjacent therapeutic areas through acquisition but lacking in-house M&A capabilities and facing a compressed timeline due to patent cliff pressures on core revenue streams.
approach: Built a strategic acquisition thesis aligned with the client's R&D pipeline and commercial capabilities. Identified and screened 40+ targets, shortlisting five for deep evaluation. Led commercial due diligence on the preferred target, developed the integration blueprint, and supported negotiation strategy through to close.
results: Completed acquisition at a 12% discount to initial valuation. Integration delivered $45M in commercial synergies within first year. New therapeutic area now represents 28% of total revenue and is growing at 19% annually.

client: A Series D enterprise software company
challenge: Plateauing growth at $180M ARR with enterprise sales cycles lengthening and increasing customer acquisition costs threatening path to profitability and upcoming IPO timeline.
approach: Conducted deep customer segmentation analysis and win/loss review across 200+ enterprise opportunities. Redesigned the go-to-market model with differentiated approaches for each segment. Restructured pricing architecture and introduced a product-led growth motion for mid-market penetration.
results: Reignited growth to 34% YoY from 18%. Reduced enterprise CAC by 28% through improved targeting. Mid-market segment grew from 12% to 31% of new bookings. Successfully completed IPO at $4.2B valuation.
